codingPatterns.title: Coding Test Patterns
codingPatterns.description: Master coding tests with 15 essential algorithm patterns

whatIs.title: What are Coding Test Patterns?
whatIs.description: A study tool covering 15 core algorithm patterns that repeatedly appear in coding interviews. Each pattern includes recognition signals, step-by-step approach, pseudocode, and classic problems.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Browse patterns by category or search
Learn the 'When to Use' signals first
Study the pseudocode and implement in your preferred language

tips.title: Study Tips
items: Pattern recognition is the most important skill to develop
Start with easy patterns (Two Pointers, HashMap) to build confidence
One pattern per day — complete all 15 in just two weeks
Study related patterns together to improve problem classification

items.a: Yes, these 15 patterns cover the vast majority of coding test problems. Advanced problems often combine multiple patterns.
Easy (Two Pointers, HashMap, Tree Traversal) → Medium (BFS/DFS, Binary Search, Sliding Window) → Hard (DP, Topological Sort).
